newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 17.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose 56.57 points to 6,935.46.
* The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index of 100 large-capitalisation stocks on Friday fell 7.29 to 1,242.47.

* Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad is launching Malaysia Electric Corp Bhd's MEC City, an electrical appliances industrial town in Pahang state. Malaysia Electric is a wholly-owned unit of Kuala Lumpur Industries Holdings Bhd.
